name: Combobox
summary: A text field that filters a long list as you type and keeps one value from it. The list opens under the field; focus stays in the field while the arrow keys move through the matches.
useWhen: One value from a long list (more than about 12 options) that people find faster by typing, such as a city, a country or a person
Options people know by name or by a code, such as an airport code, which keywords on the options can match
A value that must be one of the options, never free text
avoidWhen: Any text is a valid answer and the options are only suggestions
A short list of options that reads well without typing
Searching a whole site or running commands

items.description: The options, plain ({ value, label, description?, start?, disabled?, keywords? }) or in titled groups ({ label, options }), as ListBox takes them. Filtered by the label, then the keywords, best matches first inside each group.

value.description: The chosen option value, controlled with onValueChange. null: none.

onValueChange.description: Called with the chosen value, or null when cleared (the clear button, a second Escape, or an emptied field on blur).

inputValue.description: The text in the field, controlled with onInputValueChange. Use it to fetch options from a server as people type, with loading.

onInputValueChange.description: Called with the text on every keystroke.

open.description: The popup is open, controlled with onOpenChange.

size.description: Field height from size.control (28, 32, 44px at default density). sm lists use sm rows; md and lg lists use list.row.height. lg uses a fixed 16px type so phones do not zoom.

shape.description: default: the style's control radius (a pill in Studio and Desk). pill: always fully round.

invalid.description: The danger border and aria-invalid. Inside a Field it follows the Field's error.

disabled.description: Native disabled on the input; the list never opens. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

readOnly.description: The value shows and can be copied, not changed: no list, no clear button, a dashed border.

loading.description: Options are on their way: the trigger shows a spinner, the popup and the status say loadingLabel, data-loading and aria-busy are set.

loadingLabel.description: What the popup and the status say while loading. Arabic default: جار تحميل الخيارات.

empty.description: Shown in the popup when nothing matches. Arabic default: ما فيه نتائج. جرب كلمة ثانية. null shows no popup.

formatCount.description: The words read for the result count, once typing pauses. Default 3 results, pluralized with Intl.PluralRules in Arabic (نتيجة وحدة، نتيجتين، 5 نتائج، 12 نتيجة).

loop.description: ArrowDown on the last option goes to the first.

triggerLabel.description: The name of the opener button. Arabic default: عرض الخيارات.

clearLabel.description: The name of the clear button. Arabic default: مسح القيمة.

name.description: Submits the value under this name in a form, through a hidden input.

placeholder.description: A hint inside the empty field. Never the only label: wrap the Combobox in a Field with a label.

a11y.role: combobox (ARIA 1.2) on the input, aria-autocomplete list, aria-expanded, aria-controls pointing at the listbox in the popup, aria-activedescendant pointing at the highlighted option. The popup has no role of its own; it holds a ListBox named like the field. Not modal.
a11y.focus: Focus stays in the input the whole time, so the open popup holds no tab stop. data-state open and closed is stamped on the popup part, not on the field root. The trigger and clear buttons are not in the tab order (tabindex -1) and keep focus in the input when pressed. On blur the list closes and the field shows the chosen label again.

keys.Tab: Moves into the field and out of it; the list closes
keys.ArrowDown: Closed: opens the list on the chosen option, else the first. Open: moves to the next option, skipping disabled ones, wrapping at the end
keys.ArrowUp: Closed: opens the list on the last option. Open: moves to the previous option
keys.Alt+ArrowDown: Opens the list without moving the highlight
keys.Alt+ArrowUp: Chooses the highlighted option and closes the list
keys.Enter: Chooses the highlighted option and closes the list; it does not submit the form while an option is highlighted
keys.Escape: Open: closes the list and puts the chosen label back. Closed: clears the field and the value. Inside a Dialog, the Escape after the list closed closes the Dialog (Radix handles Escape on the document first); clear with the clear button or by selecting the text there
keys.Typing: Filters the list and opens it; the first match is highlighted so Enter picks it

a11y.announce: The input reads its Field label, its value, and that it has a list. Moving through the list reads each option (label, description, selected, position). After each query the count is read once, politely, from a visually hidden status (3 results; in Arabic 3 نتائج).
notes: Matching ignores case, accents, Arabic diacritics and the tatweel, and unifies alef forms, alef maqsura, ta marbuta and the hamza seats (normalize in @the-system/shared filter.ts).
The matched part of each option is wrapped in mark, drawn heavier and underlined, never by color alone (WCAG 1.4.1).
The trigger and clear buttons are 24px IconButtons (WCAG 2.5.8) with names; the list can also be opened with the keys.
The popup is portaled into a Theme copied from the field's Theme and is its own root carrying data-part popup, as a DropdownMenu submenu is; its z-index is z.menu so it shows over a Dialog.

Contract: the suite reads Combobox as a field, not an overlay: its popup never holds a tab stop (focus stays in the input), which the overlay checks require. data-state open and closed is on the popup root only. ArrowDown is checked on the input of the many case (aria-expanded changes) and Escape there with the list closed (the value clears). Opening, the popup anatomy and axe on the open popup are covered by the unit tests and a lane axe run (docs/reports/lanes/lane-3c.md).
The list is named like the field: through the Field label, else aria-label or aria-labelledby on the Combobox. Without a Field, pass one of them.

en.label: A noun in a Field label: City, Country, Assignee.
en.placeholder: Optional, a verb plus a noun: Search cities. Not a repeat of the label.
en.options: Nouns as people write them, sentence case: Abu Dhabi, Al Ahsa.
en.empty: Say what to try next: No results. Try another word.
en.error: Say what to do: Choose a city from the list.

ar.label: Noun form, no diacritics: المدينة.
ar.empty: ما فيه نتائج. جرب كلمة ثانية.
ar.count: Pluralized with Intl.PluralRules (one, two, few, many and other forms), Western digits.

react.behavior: radix:Popover (Root, Anchor, Content); the combobox and the list hand built on ListBox
react.note: The base (ComboboxBase.tsx) is shared with Autocomplete. The popup surface is styled in Combobox.css for the whole list family; MultiSelect and TagField add their names to its selector lists. Sources GoBanana and Figma-Killer-2 were not reachable in the lane session; the field follows Input and the popup the DropdownMenu surface.

angular.behavior: div[dsCombobox], hand built: a CDK ComponentPortal popup placed with the Radix Popper steps (internal/popper.ts), a ListBox with virtualFocus, the highlight on the CDK ActiveDescendantKeyManager, the shared filter.ts and listbox.ts, ControlValueAccessor
angular.note: The host is the root (the Radix Anchor, with its class and data-radix-popper-side and -align). Inputs take the React prop names; onValueChange, onOpenChange and onInputValueChange are the valueChange, openChange and inputValueChange outputs of [(value)], [(open)] and [(inputValue)]. Native input props React spreads on the input (placeholder, id, name, aria-label, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby) are inputs. empty takes text or a TemplateRef. The popup is not a CDK Overlay pane: the same DOM and position as Radix Popover. Angular Aria Combobox would replace the key manager once @angular/aria is installed. Combobox.css is used as is.

native.behavior: hand built: a TextInput and a FlatList in a sheet

styles.studio: The field is the Input box: a transparent pill with the control border, the glow and the ring on focus. The popup is the Studio menu surface: surface-3, the card radius, the menu shadow; the lit row takes the overlay step.
styles.desk: The same field. The popup is the Desk menu glass: the strong material and blur, a hairline, the panel radius with field radius rows, regular weight; the lit row is the yellow primary fill with dark text. Under reduced transparency and more contrast the glass turns solid.

mistakes.wrong: A Combobox where any typed text is a fine answer
A placeholder as the only label
mistakes.right: A Field with a label around the Combobox

mistakes.wrong: Moving focus into the list with the arrow keys
mistakes.right: Focus stays in the input; aria-activedescendant points at the option (built in)

mistakes.wrong: An empty popup that says nothing when no option matches
mistakes.right: empty says what to try next: No results. Try another word.

mistakes.wrong: Filtering only the exact spelling of Arabic names
mistakes.right: The shared normalize: أبها matches ابها, جدة matches جده

mistakes.wrong: Announcing the result count on every keystroke
mistakes.right: Once per query after typing pauses, in a polite status (built in)

mistakes.wrong: A Combobox with no Field and no aria-label
mistakes.right: A Field label, or aria-label: the input and its list both need a name
